svg.title: Cecil and Riju find that the Bengali consent branch authorises broader data use.
svg.desc: The English field limits use to this request; the working Bengali field grants use across connected services. Both strings come from the reviewed-overlay manifest rather than generated art. Cecil indicates the broader branch while Riju marks the discrepancy.
